theorems.name: Submission.cbr_ci_pw_mu_conv_lipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (φ : Euclid n → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) φ → HasCompactSupport φ → ∃ L : ℝ, 0 ≤ L ∧ ∀ (S : Set (Euclid n)) (v : Euclid n → ℝ), IntegrableOn v S → ∀ x x' : Euclid n, |(∫ y in S, v y * φ (x - y)) - ∫ y in S, v y * φ (x' - y)| ≤ L * (∫ y in S, |v y|) * dist x x'
